Metabolic Research

Tirzepatide

WHAT IS IT?

A dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist studied in metabolic and body-weight research.

COMMON AREAS OF RESEARCH

Weight management • Appetite regulation • Glucose metabolism

HOW IT WORKS

Activates GIP and GLP-1 receptors involved in appetite signaling, digestion, and insulin release.

WHY RESEARCHERS ARE INTERESTED

Researchers are interested in how its two-pathway mechanism may influence appetite and metabolic balance.

Retatrutide

WHAT IS IT?

An investigational triple receptor agonist targeting GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon pathways.

COMMON AREAS OF RESEARCH

Weight management • Metabolic health • Energy expenditure

HOW IT WORKS

Activates three receptor pathways involved in appetite, glucose regulation, and energy balance.

WHY RESEARCHERS ARE INTERESTED

Its three-pathway design makes it a major focus of next-generation metabolic research.

Growth Hormone Research

Tesamorelin

WHAT IS IT?

A growth hormone-releasing hormone analogue studied for natural growth hormone signaling.

COMMON AREAS OF RESEARCH

Growth hormone release • IGF-1 production • Body composition

HOW IT WORKS

Stimulates the pituitary gland to increase endogenous growth hormone secretion.

WHY RESEARCHERS ARE INTERESTED

Researchers study its effects on growth hormone signaling and body-composition pathways.

Sermorelin

WHAT IS IT?

A GHRH analogue commonly researched for natural growth hormone release.

COMMON AREAS OF RESEARCH

Growth hormone secretion • Recovery research • Healthy-aging research

HOW IT WORKS

Signals the pituitary gland to release growth hormone in a pattern related to normal physiology.

WHY RESEARCHERS ARE INTERESTED

Researchers use it to examine natural growth hormone rhythms and related recovery pathways.

CJC (No DAC) + Ipamorelin

WHAT IS IT?

A two-peptide combination studied for pulsatile growth hormone release.

COMMON AREAS OF RESEARCH

Growth hormone secretion • Recovery research • Sleep research

HOW IT WORKS

Uses two complementary pathways to promote short, pulse-like growth hormone signaling.

WHY RESEARCHERS ARE INTERESTED

The blend is studied because the ingredients approach growth hormone release through different receptors.

Reconstitution Research Supplies

What Is Bacteriostatic Water?

Bacteriostatic water is sterile, nonpyrogenic water containing benzyl alcohol as a preservative. The preservative helps limit bacterial growth after the vial has been entered, allowing the container to be used as a multi-dose diluent when appropriate laboratory procedures are followed.

Generic BAC Water — 10mL

WHAT IT IS

A general bacteriostatic-water option intended for research reconstitution and dilution.

KEY FEATURE

Contains a bacteriostatic preservative designed to help reduce bacterial growth during repeated laboratory withdrawals.

COMMON USE

A practical everyday option for compatible research products when a smaller vial is preferred.

HANDLING

Use sterile laboratory technique and follow the handling requirements for the specific research material being prepared.

Hospira Bacteriostatic Water — 30mL

WHAT IT IS

USP bacteriostatic water supplied by Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer company, in a pharmaceutical multi-dose vial.

FORMULATION

A sterile, nonpyrogenic preparation containing 0.9% benzyl alcohol as a bacteriostatic preservative.

WHY IT IS CHOSEN

Often selected when a pharmaceutical-manufacturer option, larger volume, or clearly labeled USP product is preferred.

IMPORTANT NOTE

The manufacturer labeling should be followed, including compatibility, storage, and multi-dose handling instructions.

Research Handling Reminder

Always confirm that the selected diluent is compatible with the specific research product. Protect supplies from contamination and follow appropriate laboratory storage and aseptic-handling procedures.
